_comment: Abstract concept nodes (in addition to the document nodes that build_kb.py generates from manifest.json). type=concept. Document nodes have type=document.

concepts.label: Riemann Hypothesis (RH)
concepts.summary: All non-trivial zeros of ζ have Re(s)=1/2.

concepts.label: Generalized/Grand RH
concepts.summary: RH for all Dirichlet resp. automorphic L-functions.

concepts.label: Euler product (multiplicativity)
concepts.summary: ζ(s)=∏(1-p^-s)^-1; encodes the prime structure. Key property without which off-line zeros are possible.

concepts.label: Positivity / real-rootedness
concepts.summary: RH as a positive quadratic form resp. a real-only-zeros statement (Weil, Li, de Branges, Jensen, Lee-Yang, dBN).

concepts.label: Hilbert–Pólya / spectral interpretation
concepts.summary: Zeros = eigenvalues of a self-adjoint/canonical operator.

concepts.label: Geometry transfer (function fields→ℤ)
concepts.summary: Transferring Weil's/Deligne's proven RH analogue over 𝔽_q to Spec(ℤ).

concepts.label: Explicit formula (primes↔zeros)
concepts.summary: Weil/von Mangoldt: links Σ over zeros with Σ over primes; the common core of all trace-formula/positivity approaches.

concepts.label: Critical line Re(s)=1/2
concepts.summary: Conjectured location of all non-trivial zeros.
